subject: GLC This Week: Craft et Veritas, Accountability Cafe, Friend Matching
text:
THE GOOD LIFE CENTER | THIS WEEK

Craft et Veritas
Mondays 3-4pm, YSC Offline Oasis. This week (10/19): visual roadmaps for the rest of the semester.

Accountability Cafe
Mon Oct 19, 10am-4pm, Silliman Acorn. Pre-break coworking with YC3. Drop in for an hour or stay all day.

YC3 Friend Matching
The survey closes Tuesday 10/20. Fill it out to get matched with someone new.

On display all year: the Gamelatron Auric Obsidian (8 bronze gongs) in the GLC Tea Room, YSC 208.

Be well,
The Good Life Center
